title: edilint stats JSON report, version 1
description: The document `edilint stats --json` writes: one census covering every file examined in one invocation. The `version` field is incremented, and a new schema file committed, whenever a consumer written against the previous version could meet something it has not seen before.

version.description: The document shape version. This schema describes version 1.

files.description: One census per input file, in the order the files were given. Always an array, [] when no file could be read.

fileStats.description: The census of one input file. The separator, charset and envelope sections apply only to X12 input and are absent otherwise.

file.description: The input path as given, "-" for standard input.

format.description: The detected structural family of the input.

bytes.description: The input size as read, byte order mark included.

records.description: The number of records with content: segments for X12 and EDIFACT, non-blank lines otherwise.

records_by_id.description: The record histogram, keyed by segment identifier or record type. Absent when the format assigns no record types, as in a delimited file whose leading field holds data.

separators.description: The separators the interchange declared in its ISA.

repetition.description: Absent when ISA11 declares no repetition separator, as in a 004010 interchange.

charset.description: The narrowest X12 character-set profile that admits every content character observed. Structural characters and control characters are not classified.

extended_only.description: Characters legal in the extended set but not the basic set.

beyond_extended.description: Characters outside even the extended set, non-ASCII included.

envelope.description: The X12 envelope census. A range is absent when no envelope declared the value; only well-formed all-digit dates of the declared width are sampled.

groups_by_code.description: Functional group counts keyed by GS01 functional identifier code.

transactions_by_type.description: Transaction set counts keyed by ST01 transaction set identifier code.

valueRange.description: The least and greatest of a sampled set of values. Values that parse as integers are ordered numerically, anything else lexically.
